##### Project general facts

Burj Azizi by Azizi Developments is a landmark supertall tower set to become the second tallest building in the world, rising to one hundred and thirty-one floors. Conceived as an architectural marvel that brings together world cultures and sensory experiences, the tower combines hotel apartments on its lower residential levels, private apartments above and penthouses and royal penthouses at the top, all with floor-to-ceiling windows and sweeping views of the skyline and the Arabian Gulf.

The tower hosts a seven-star hotel with record-breaking lobby and rooms, an observation deck, the tallest nightclub in the world and the highest restaurant in the city, together with seven floors of high-end boutiques and luxury brands. Residents enjoy an infinity pool, a spa with a sauna, a steam room and a jacuzzi, a fully equipped gym, a yoga area, a cinema, a clubhouse, party and games rooms, an indoor children's play area and a separate automated parking structure.

Residences combine spacious layouts with contemporary design, premium materials and panoramic glazing that frames the city, the sea and the desert horizon. One- to three-bedroom apartments suit professionals and families, while larger penthouses offer exceptional space and privacy at the very top of the tower. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Sheikh Zayed Road is the main business and lifestyle artery of Dubai, lined with landmark towers, hotels, offices and restaurants. The Trade Centre district around the tower combines the Dubai World Trade Centre, the Dubai International Financial Centre, Emirates Towers and Za'abeel Park, creating a vibrant urban setting at the centre of the city with everyday services, dining and entertainment close at hand.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Al Wasl Road connect residents with the wider city, and the World Trade Centre and Emirates Towers metro stations are close by. Downtown Dubai and The Dubai Mall are a short drive away, Dubai International Airport is close by, and Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable driving distance.

Sheikh Zayed Road offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most prestigious and liquid residential addresses in Dubai. A globally recognised landmark tower with branded hotel services, luxury retail and record-breaking attractions draws high-net-worth buyers and premium tenants from around the world. Scarcity, iconic status and a central position underpin strong rental demand and long-term capital value.
